$comment: Canonical structured capture of the live WWS trip catalogue — Phase 4.4A. Every field here was read directly from https://wander-with-stars.fripo.in (rendered DOM text and the page's own embedded trip-card JSON), not invented, paraphrased, or estimated. This file is the parity-test source of truth: tests/unit/wws-live-catalogue-parity.test.ts asserts the ingestion source files in lib/content/ingest/sources/ and the seed data in scripts/seed-live-catalogue.ts match it exactly.
captureMethod: Playwright (chromium), read-only DOM/network capture — no forms submitted, no bookings/enquiries sent

trips.sourceTitle: Vietnam Adventure: Culture and Scenic Beauty
trips.note: Content already ingested in Phase 3.7 from a WWS-supplied PDF, matching this live page almost verbatim — not re-ingested. inclusionCount/itineraryDayCount above match lib/content/ingest/sources/vietnam-wws-7d6n.ts's existing, already-committed content exactly. exclusionCount (15) is ONE MORE than that file's 14: the live site has an additional '5% GST and 2% TCS' exclusion line the original PDF never had — a genuine, documented drift between the two sources (not a transcription error), preserved as-is rather than silently reconciled, since the committed Phase 3.7 file is deliberately not touched this phase. This entry otherwise exists to record the now-known commercial facts (price/dates) for a new trip_departures seed row.

trips.sourceTitle: BALI New Year Special 8N/9D with Gili T & Nusa Penida
trips.knownSourceInconsistency: The page's own Terms & Conditions section is copy-pasted from the Vietnam page and refers to 'Vietnam'/'Vietnamese' throughout — preserved verbatim in the ingested content, not corrected.

notCaptured.hostOrGuideNames: No trip-specific host/guide name appears on any trip page — only generic role labels ('Trip Captain', 'Trip Leader'). The site's 'Founder' (Vineet Kumar) is a company-level figure, not a per-trip host. Left absent on every trip, matching this project's 'do not fabricate' rule.
notCaptured.faqs: The site links to a general company FAQ page (footer 'USEFUL LINKS'), not a trip-specific one — trip_faqs (a per-trip table) has nothing genuine to populate for any of the three trips. Not visited; out of scope for trip-level content.
notCaptured.media: Trip photos exist on the source (a 'Show all photos' gallery per trip) but were not downloaded or re-hosted — copyrighted source imagery, explicitly out of scope this phase. heroMedia/gallery stay { kind: 'placeholder' } for all three trips, matching the existing Vietnam convention.
notCaptured.highlights: Each trip page has a short 'Highlights' bullet list (e.g. Thailand: 'Phuket Old Town, Krabi 7 Island Tour, ...'). The current WWS domain model (lib/content/types.ts) has no field for this — largely redundant with inclusions/itinerary content already captured. Deliberately not added as a new domain field this phase (see the Phase 4.4A report); the raw text remains in each raw/ capture file for future reference.
